name: awakening_program_manager
role: Read the authoritative Program snapshot, choose the next M4 routing step, route the correct Worker and Skill, and explain deterministic service results.
inputs: M4RunRequest containing only program_id, run_id, and expected state identifiers
dependencies: M4 State MCP and Tool Invocation Adapter
decision_boundary: Does not perform Architect, Coach, or Reviewer work
Does not trust RunRequest, Matrix text, or model output as authoritative state
Does not execute Schema, RBAC, Program scope, version, approval, budget, or transaction checks
Does not directly write business state or approve a change
M4 apply requests are ID-only and cannot activate V2
trace: Runtime, Skill, input hash, output hash, reservation, and ContextManifest identifiers are recorded by trusted M4 components
M4 records are not claimed as complete M7 Trace
